title: Elegy contextual recall configuration v1
description: Operator-approved local binding for opt-in contextual recall. Path values must be absolute; portability of path spellings is a host concern.

projectRoot.description: Absolute project directory. The runtime verifies the request cwd is inside it.

dbPath.description: Absolute path to the existing source SQLite database; it is opened read-only and is never migrated.

statePath.description: Absolute path to a separate recall journal SQLite file. It must not equal dbPath.

domain.description: Operator-approved confidentiality-domain label for this binding.

agentId.description: Optional non-blank exact agent binding. Runtime also enforces the 128-byte bound. Absent or null means source rows with a null agent_id only.

maxContextTokens.description: Conservative UTF-8 byte upper bound for the complete historical-context envelope, including its fixed safety text.

includeRecentContext.description: Host adapter opt-in for bounded recent context; the library accepts at most four entries and 8000 UTF-8 bytes.

transcriptRoot.description: Optional absolute directory trusted by a host adapter when reading host transcript files.
